_readme: Confessional heuristic pools, externalized (voice pipeline step 1). Keys: kind -> bucket -> lines. Buckets: base (always), anxious/catty/bold (personality gates), even (mid-range deadpan), partner/lost/enemy (only when the event text yields that token). Tokens in {braces} are filled at draw time; a line whose token is unavailable is skipped for that draw. Grow these pools with tools/generate_dialogue.py against a local model.

base: Camera only? Fine. I {detail}. There. I said it.
Okay. Deep breath. The truth is... I {detail}. Cut that. Actually, keep it.
Nobody out there knows this, but I {detail}. And honestly? Relief.
anxious: If this ever airs I'm finished, but — I {detail}. Oh no.
catty: Yes, I {detail}. And I'd do it again. Next question.
bold: Since we're being honest: I {detail}. Stay tuned.

base: That's a wrap on me. Try not to fall apart without me.
I came, I worked, I left. Somebody water the plant.
No regrets. Well. A few. But you don't get to hear them.
bold: This office couldn't hold me. Nothing personal.
anxious: I just hope leaving isn't a huge mistake. It might be. Bye.
catty: Finally. You know who you are, and you know what you did.

base: I'm {name} — {desc}. Remember the name.
They call me {name}. I'm {desc}, and I'm not here to blend in.
{name}. {desc_cap}. That's the whole pitch.
bold: I'm {name}, and let's be honest — this office just got interesting.
anxious: Hi, um, {name}. I really hope this goes well. It probably won't.
catty: I'm {name}. I already have opinions about everyone here.

base: Honestly? I did not see that coming. But I'm not mad about it.
People are gonna talk. Let them talk.
Is it real? Ask me again in three days.
anxious: I've replayed it a hundred times. What if it all falls apart?
bold: I make things happen. This place needed a little heat.
even: We're keeping it professional. At work. Mostly.
partner: {partner}. Yeah. I know exactly what I'm doing. ...No I don't.
Whatever happens with {partner}, the cameras got it first. Great.

base: You never think it'll actually happen. And then it does.
We weren't close, but... the office feels different now.
I keep expecting them to walk back in.
anxious: I can't stop thinking about it. Who's next?
even: Somebody should water their plant. I'll do it. It's fine.
lost: {lost} deserved better than this place gave them.
I had a joke ready for {lost} this morning. Guess I'll keep it.

base: They started it. We're just going to finish it.
May the best team win. It'll be us.
There's us, and there's them. Pick a side.
catty: Bless their hearts. They really think they stand a chance.
bold: Bring it. I've been waiting for a reason.
even: I don't do drama. I do winning quietly.
enemy: {enemy}? Never heard of them. Kidding. We're going to bury them.

base: You can't make this stuff up. Except, well, here we are.
I'm just here to do my job. The chaos finds me.
I have seen things at this water cooler. Things.
HR is going to LOVE this week's footage.
Don't look at me. I was at my desk. Allegedly.
catty: I'm not saying I told you so. But I told you so.
anxious: My stomach's been in knots all day. Something's off.
even: On a scale of one to office meltdown? Solid seven.
